english: Let $u=\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\\1\end{pmatrix}$ and $v=\begin{pmatrix}2\\-1\\2\end{pmatrix}$, and let $M=I+uv^{T}$, where $I$ is the $3\times3$ identity matrix and $v^{T}$ is the transpose of $v$. If $\left(M^{T}\right)^{-1}=I+\lambda\,vu^{T}$ for a real number $\lambda$, then the value of $\lambda$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $u=\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\\1\end{pmatrix}$ तथा $v=\begin{pmatrix}2\\-1\\2\end{pmatrix}$ है, और $M=I+uv^{T}$ है, जहाँ $I$, $3\times3$ तत्समक आव्यूह है तथा $v^{T}$, $v$ का परिवर्त है। यदि किसी वास्तविक संख्या $\lambda$ के लिए $\left(M^{T}\right)^{-1}=I+\lambda\,vu^{T}$ है, तो $\lambda$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Here $vu^{T}$ is a $3\times3$ matrix and $u^{T}v$ is a $1\times1$ matrix, i.e. the number $1\cdot2+1\cdot(-1)+1\cdot2=3$.
Since $vu^{T}=\begin{pmatrix}2&2&2\\-1&-1&-1\\2&2&2\end{pmatrix}\neq O$, the product equals $I$ exactly when $1+4\lambda=0$, i.e. $\lambda=-\dfrac14$.
A right inverse of a square matrix is its inverse, so $\left(M^{T}\right)^{-1}=I-\dfrac14vu^{T}$ and $\lambda=-0.25$.
originality_note: New: the inverse of the transpose of a rank-one update I + u v^T is found by associativity, using that u^T v is a scalar (way 5). Closest known: the Sherman-Morrison formula from linear algebra and JEE questions with A = column times row. Different because: the student must transpose first (the update becomes v u^T) and then use u^T v = 3 to collapse the product.

concept_use.Matrix Multiplication & Algebraic Proper: Associativity turns (v u^T)(v u^T) into v (u^T v) u^T = 3 v u^T, which makes the product (I + v u^T)(I + lambda v u^T) collapse.
concept_use.Transpose: properties and (AB)^T = B^T A: (I + u v^T)^T = I + v u^T by the transpose rules for sums and products.

stem_review: Read as a student: every matrix and symbol is defined before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed with sympy and is unique and equal to the Answer Plan; no hyperbolic functions or asymptotes. Checked: sympy confirms (M^T)^{-1} = I - (1/4) v u^T exactly; -0.25 is a negative decimal as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Using u^T v = 3 to get (v u^T)^2 = 3 v u^T, then solving 1 + 4 lambda = 0.
justification: A short routine chain (transpose of a product, associativity, solve a linear condition); the rank-one idea is familiar from 'column times row' exercises. Same weight as the routine matrix identities of 2021-P1-Q11 (L2).
